title: CapabilityConformanceVectors
description: DD-102 / ADR-12：能力契约固定的机器向量。每个 case 按 steps 顺序执行契约操作，参数与预期结果是实际 JSON，不执行文本代码。格式有效不表示组件套件通过；线协议性质、真实执行与 release 证据关联另行核验。DD-124：V2 的每个值只来自 LITERAL、PRECONDITION 或 CAPTURE；generatedRefs、preconditionKinds、preconditions、bindings 与 captures 只属于 V2，V1 仍按原规则执行。

generatedRefs.description: V2 only. Contract fields whose values the implementation generates (opaque non-empty strings). nativeRevision is always implementation-generated and need not be listed. A listed position present in a step document may never be LITERAL; EXPECTED entries are the only output fields a GENERATED_REF capture of a FORWARD step may read. A RECEIVER step is not sent by the production Core: its input is the receiver admission the isolated Core produced, so a GENERATED_REF capture of that step reads an INPUT entry of its own contract key.

preconditionKinds.description: V2 only. Closed list of native object kinds a case may declare as preconditions and the properties each must verify by a literal expectation.

preconditions.description: V2 only. Native objects the isolated fixture creates through the candidate's own native entry before the run; the fixture supplies only their actual identifiers. Every registered property of the kind is declared with its literal value and verified by a later literal expectation of this case.

referenceFromStepKey.description: V1 only. 只引用同 case 已成功的更早 stepKey 的唯一 typed ContentReference；不得指定 JSON 路径或表达式。与固定 Resource/Asset 目标一起进入规范化参数 hash。

bindings.description: V2 only. Every reserved placeholder in inputJson/expectedOutputJson is declared here exactly once.

captures.description: V2 only. Values this step's SUCCEEDED observation with complete native terminal evidence provides to later steps.

direction.description: V2 only; absent means FORWARD. A RECEIVER step (DD-124(4)) runs in the isolated deployment and is observed by the production plan only through receiver_start/receiver_observe. It names the receiver Resource in referenceResourceId and expects {}. Its inputJson describes the receiver admission the isolated Core performs; there it may bind the step's own ACTION_EXECUTION_ID, OPERATION_ID or GENERATED_REF captures where that admission carries identifiers the isolated Core or the implementation generated. Its evidence is the isolated run's native batch or execution, both read_receipts and the native terminal status, all generated in this run.
